findings.rationale: The IAM policy allows all actions ('*') on a resource, violating the principle of least privilege.
The IAM policy grants access to all resources ('*'), which provides overly broad permissions.
An IAM policy with wildcard actions and resources is chained with an S3 bucket configured for public-read access, creating a potential exposure.
